native_ab.scope: Twelve paired quotes from the same actual issuer and observation time. NAV is the pure-NAV counterfactual of the same cash/claims/liabilities/units. AI trading is disabled in this isolated pricing fixture; this is not a multi-country macro balance experiment.
native_ab.price_formula_checks: All twelve observed market quotes agree with rounded NAV times exp(log premium) within 0.001 gold.

persistence: Twelve natural observed closes; test fixture freezes only its pricing clock after close 12, waits for the following yearly autosave, and finishes at month 24. A second process checks saved seed/premium/draw count before any grants. The separate next-shock primitive records pre-grant NAV and supplies 5000 gold to isolate a solvent draw from year-two native cash changes. Freeze/grants are fixture-only, not production behavior or campaign-profit evidence.

offline.checked: All CSV summaries independently reconcile; normal moments/full PRNG period and checkpoint replay checked. Synthetic prices use the same rounded NAV anchor/quantile precision; reference order quantities/cash use continuous arithmetic, while native assertions separately verify share/cent rounding. Percentiles are path distributions, not confidence intervals.

backend_config.note: Backend explicitly exposes the existing 5% dealer resale default; regeneration is byte-identical to the accepted runtime. Optional non-default settings are sensitivity-tested offline; not every combination has its own native campaign.

financial_provenance: The 40/54/114 regressions retain financial-runtime ff891754; shipping 767c813d differs only in scripted_guis/bfl_account_commands.txt (matching button/command guard) and localization. All financial effects, values, prices and settlement files are byte-identical. The 31-case pricing suite and cold-loaded final UI exercise shipping.
historical: Prior 245-assertion full M5 gate and 208-assertion portfolio follow-up retain their original fingerprints. Unchanged treasury paths are not relabeled as newly rerun. Earlier duplicate pricing runs are not added to the 239 final assertion count.
scope: Pinned single-player baseline. Controlled pricing A/B and actual UI do not establish release-wide macroeconomic balance, normal campaign profits, independent real-market tails or every alternate backend configuration; M10 retains calibration/performance/AI integration.
